'''Dark Oak Sign''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Stonecutter]] recipe (from <span class="explain" title="Dark Oak Log, Dark Oak Wood, Stripped Dark Oak Log, Stripped Dark Oak Wood">any dark oak logs</span>). See {{MCW|Dark Oak Sign}} for everything else.
